caption: Dusky grouse hen in aspen. Mottled brown and grey, long dark tail.
author: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve

caption: Dusky grouse male displaying in sagebrush. Slate grey body, red air sacs and a yellow orange comb over the eye.
author: YellowstoneNPS
cardBack: Dusky grouse male. Slate grey, long dark tail with a pale grey band at the tip. Big for a grouse.

caption: Ruffed grouse in fall leaves. Barred brown and grey, small crest, fan shaped tail with a dark band near the tip.
author: Mdf
cardBack: Ruffed grouse. Fan tail with one dark band near the tip, small crest, barred body. Aspen and alder bottoms.

caption: Sharp tailed grouse in summer grass. Pale and spotted, short pointed tail.
author: Cephas
cardBack: Sharp tailed grouse. Pale, spotted (not barred) below, short pointed tail with white sides in flight. Grassland and aspen edges.

caption: Sharp tailed grouse in snow near Fort St. John, BC. Spotted body, pale tail.
author: Gerry from Fort St. John, BC, Canada

caption: Spruce grouse hen. Heavy black and white barring on a brown body. Conifer forest floor.
author: Alan Covington
cardBack: Spruce grouse hen. Heavily barred, smaller than a dusky grouse, sits tight in pine and spruce.
